originalPromptTexts: Humans seem naturally inclined to following strong leaders. What dangers does this inclination pose to the pursuit of truth?
How can humans learn to focus more on the joy of honest, personal truth discovery rather than on a leader who claims to possess truths?
Provide 12 accounts from history in which humans were enticed to follow a strong leader into destructive actions.
Some suggest that, unless you can clearly articulate the faults of an individual you respect, you are in danger of following them in a destructive direction. Comment on this notion.
Create a 10-item quiz on the entire thread above.
